collisionPolicy: Only new source-timed poses inside the half-open 300 ms danger interval can hit. Danger steps, pose age and pose gaps must remain at most 150 ms through final outcome settlement. A clean dodge waits for the first post-danger source sample. Motion between observations is not inferred; sufficiently fast unsampled motion can be missed.
environment: Windows local verification used Node 24.16.0, pnpm 11.25.0 and the existing repository-local Python 3.12.14 environment. Repository pins remain Node 24.21.0 and Python 3.12.16; no global environment was changed. Browser: Microsoft Edge, local Vite server at 127.0.0.1:5182, English only.
corrections: Review and checks corrected source-time phase-boundary scoring, delayed final-danger reward settlement, strict sampling coverage through clearing, timed-endpoint source mapping, shared rehearsal clamp drift, keyboard focus, desktop stage width, 320 px scrollbar overflow and small-text contrast. The initial check failed on TypeScript narrowing; the next found an outdated touch-clamp expectation. The final complete software check passed.

checks.detail: Canonical schema drift; TypeScript and Python types; ESLint and Ruff; 278 Vitest tests across 10 files; 54 pytest tests; Prettier and Python formatting. Includes 82 new Dodgeball cases.

checks.detail: All three Vite entry pages build: diagnostics, Mole Motion and Dodgeball. No new runtime dependencies.

checks.name: Browser gameplay and recovery
checks.detail: Real pointer-controlled rehearsal dodge scored 100 points and one dodge. Feet loss froze score, ball phase/progress and the timed round across separate observations. Explicit resume displayed a 2-second countdown and returned to play. End/results and Play again were observed.

checks.name: Responsive and keyboard UI
checks.detail: Real server at 1440×1000, 390×844 and 320×740. Exact feet warning fits; final 320 px viewport has clientWidth=scrollWidth=305 with a 15 px browser scrollbar, all game/settings/nav bounds inside the client. Start/resume focuses the stage; end/restart focuses the next action. Shared Mole navigation also checked at 320 px.

checks.name: Documentation and report
checks.detail: 79 relative Markdown links/anchors; Git whitespace; HTML structure; 7 embedded JPEGs decoded in Edge; no remote assets. Real-server desktop/mobile report rendering and in-report image expansion verified.

review.scope: Independent gpt-6.1-sol review with high-detail source, regression, visual and delivery inspection. Ratings cover the experimental single-player software; physical hardware and participant certification remain excluded and explicitly unverified.
review.iterations: Source review identified and verified timing, coverage, input-boundary, focus, contrast and layout corrections. Final dimensional ratings are recorded after the report and issue-linked PR are inspectable.
